list.name: May：
list.en: Good morning, Zhouzhou.

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: Morning, May.

list.name: May：
list.en: Look at my cat.

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: It's fat and funny.

list.name: Zhouzhou：
list.en: Hi, I'm Zhouzhou. Look at the bird. It's fat and funny.
list.cn: 嗨，我是州州，看这鸟。它又胖又有趣。

list.name: May：
list.en: Hello, I'm May. This is my fish. It's fat. I love it.
list.cn: 你好，我是梅。这是我的鱼。它很胖。我喜欢它。

list.name: Hanghang：
list.en: My name's Hanghang. I have a fat dog. I love my pet.
list.cn: 我叫杭杭。我有一只胖狗。我爱我的宠物。

list.name: Lee：
list.en: I'm Lee. Look at my cat. It's fat and big.
list.cn: 我是李。看我的猫。它又胖又大。

list.en: Two Little Fat Cats
Two little fat cats sitting on a hat.
list.cn: 两只小肥猫坐在帽子上。

list.en: One is Peter, one is Pat.
list.cn: 一只叫彼得，一只叫帕特。

list.en: Run away, Peter. Run away, Pat.
Come back, Peter. Come back, Pat.
